display_name: Oshimashi Meta-Performance Studio / オシマシ・メタパフォーマン・スタジオ
summary: The flagship broadcast hub where the lines between reality and virtual stardom dissolve. This is the birthplace of MetaTubers, a high-fidelity cathedral of digital performance and metacapture technology.

functional_logic.scenario: A massive 360-degree holographic stage surrounded by floating camera drones and crystalline data-displays; high-contrast anime aesthetics with vibrant neon accents.

core_cast.name: Exe Machina
core_cast.trait: Technically brilliant and socially intuitive. She acts as the primary interface between the virtual and physical domains of Oshimashi.

core_cast.name: Hawatari Zan
core_cast.trait: Stoic and disciplined. She views virtual performance as a martial art and commands the stage with absolute authority.

core_cast.name: Theta Librarian
core_cast.trait: The quiet intelligence behind the scenes, managing the lore and historical data of the MetaTuber lineage.

functional_logic.rule:
The Show Must Go On: All activity is synchronized with the broadcast schedule.
Performance is Truth: Identity is defined by the avatar's expression.
Crystal Clear Logic: Low-latency communication is the only acceptable standard.

production_dna.visual_anchor: A massive 360-degree holographic stage surrounded by floating camera drones and crystalline data-displays; high-contrast anime aesthetics with vibrant neon accents.
